summary: Abetment of suicide under IPC s.306; charge framing upheld; suicide note and audio transcripts show sustained harassment over loan recovery; existence of mens rea for abetment; demand for payment, threats, and abusive language proximate to suicide; no discharge warranted at pre-trial stage; High Court rightly declined interference.
legal_provisions_cited: Swamy Prahaladdas vs. State of M.P. and Another, 1995 Supp (3) SCC 438
Madan Mohan Singh vs. State of Gujarat and Another, (2010) 8 SCC 628
Amalendu Pal alias Jhantu vs. State of West Bengal, (2010) 1 SCC 707
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; impugned order upholding charges under s.306 IPC upheld; trial to proceed.
